full_prompt_en: A mecha anime illustration shows a young pilot in right facing three quarter profile, framed closely inside a dense system of ocher brown helmet and shoulder armor. The human face is visible through an opening beneath a large translucent violet visor, with one pale blue eye looking ahead and short dark hair falling across the brow. Thick angular helmet plates wrap around the crown and cheek; a circular mechanical housing sits at the ear, and dark joint segments fill the space behind the neck. A narrow articulated bar or communication device runs across the lower face and extends toward the right. Below, oversized chest and shoulder plates overlap in a series of bevels, vents, inset screws, and dark seams, filling the bottom and left edges of the square. The subject appears prepared and focused, but the composition gives equal attention to the physical construction of the equipment. Warm sand colored planes receive light along their upper edges, while violet visor glass, charcoal joints, and small black openings provide cool and dark counterpoints. The background is a softly mottled gray green atmosphere with no detailed setting, allowing the helmet silhouette and layered hardware to dominate. Fine ink like lines keep the design readable, and subtle weathering and grain prevent the armor from appearing sterile. Light is diffuse from the upper left, with controlled reflections on the visor and deeper shadows beneath the cheek guards. The whole image feels functional, grounded, and technically intricate while retaining a clear anime focal expression.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅机甲动漫插画描绘年轻驾驶员朝右侧三分之四转身，紧密取景于密集的赭棕色头盔与肩部装甲系统之中。人脸从一大片半透明紫色面罩下方的开口露出，一只浅蓝色眼睛望向前方，短深色头发落在眉上。厚实的棱角头盔板包住头顶与脸颊；耳旁有圆形机械组件，颈后空隙由深色关节节段填充。一根细长的活动杆或通讯装置横过面部下方，伸向右侧。下面，尺寸夸张的胸甲与肩甲通过一连串斜切边、通风槽、嵌入螺钉和深缝相互叠压，填满方形画面的底部及左缘。人物显得准备充分、注意力集中，但构图同样关注装备的物理结构。暖沙色平面在上缘承接光线，紫色面罩玻璃、炭灰关节和细小黑色开口提供冷色与暗色对照。背景是柔和斑驳的灰绿色空气，没有详细场景，使头盔剪影与层层硬件主导画面。细密的墨线式线条保持设计清楚，轻微磨损与颗粒避免装甲显得无菌。光从左上方漫射进入，在面罩上形成受控反光，在面颊护板下积成较深阴影。整幅画既功能明确、踏实且技术细节繁复，又保留清楚的动漫表情焦点。
style_prompt_en: A mecha anime rendering that combines a clear expressive focal opening with dense modular hard surface construction. Layer angular armor plates, beveled edges, circular housings, visible joints, vents, and tiny fasteners around a compact central area. Use warm sand and ocher masses, a single cool translucent accent, and charcoal mechanical recesses; keep color restrained enough that the construction reads first. Draw clean fine contours over subtle grain and modest weathering, and crop the larger armor shapes at the frame edge to imply scale. Let a softly mottled neutral background recede without competing detail. Diffuse upper side light should pick out plate edges and controlled glossy reflections while gaps remain dark. The effect is precise, functional, and cinematic.
style_prompt_zh: 采用机甲动漫渲染，把清晰而有神的焦点开口与密集的模块化硬表面结构结合。让棱角甲片、斜切边、圆形外壳、可见关节、通风槽和微小紧固件围绕紧凑的中央区域层层叠加。使用暖沙色与赭色大色块、一处冷色半透明强调，以及炭灰机械凹处；色彩克制到让结构先被读出。在微弱颗粒与适度磨损上叠加干净细线，并使较大装甲形态在画框边缘被裁切，暗示尺度。柔和斑驳的中性背景向后退去，不与主体争夺细节。漫射的上侧光应擦亮板件边缘与受控的光滑反射，缝隙维持黑暗。效果精确、功能明确且有电影感。
theme_en: Armored pilot in a modular helmet
theme_zh: 佩戴模块化头盔的装甲驾驶员
name: Mecha anime style
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
